description: Process receipt images/PDFs, including 'log this', 'save this receipt', 'expense this', 'add this to my expenses' or a shared receipt/invoice photo. Starts on call (no server preview); AI extracts vendor, amount, date, tax and category (usually 1–3 minutes; longer for PDFs/batches); poll get_last_receipt_result with the returned submissionId. Mixed images/PDFs work. Required for PDFs; use this flow for large files/batches: call filesToUpload for EVERY file; PUT each ONE AT A TIME to signed URLs, report file/count progress, then call ONCE with all uploadRefs as one batch, never once per file. photo accepts one ChatGPT image/PDF; photoBase64 only for one small image without file references. note maps to Notes L, tag to Tag K; batch defaults apply to all files and uploadRefs items may override.

filesToUpload.description: Every file the user provided, in one call. Returns signedUrl + uploadRef per file; upload each, then call with uploadRefs.

id.description: Your own identifier for this file, echoed back so you can match URLs to files. E.g. '1', '2'.

mimeType.description: MIME type; must match the PUT Content-Type exactly. The real format is re-detected from the contents.
MIME type of the file (default: image/jpeg)

note.description: Batch-level note for every file; a file may override it. Stored in the Notes column (L).

photo.description: Single attached receipt image or PDF supplied by ChatGPT. For multiple files or large files, use filesToUpload and uploadRefs instead.

photoBase64.description: Legacy fallback for MCP clients that send one small image as complete base64 data. ChatGPT should use photo or uploadRefs instead.

tag.description: Batch-level project or client tag for every row; a file may override it. Stored in the Tag column (K).

uploadRef.description: Single-file shorthand for uploadRefs. Use uploadRefs when there is more than one file.

uploadRefs.description: Every uploadRef from the filesToUpload step, as ONE batch. If any file fails validation nothing is processed.

id.description: The id you supplied in filesToUpload.

note.description: Note for this file; overrides the batch note. Stored in the Notes column (L).

tag.description: Project or client tag for this specific file. Overrides the batch-level tag and is stored in the Tag column (K).

name: submit_receipt
